violation_type.title: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care (26 TAC §747.5003(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.

finding_variants.text: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.
The emergency preparedness plan does not address countuity of care.
The emergency preparedness plan did not contain the contuinty of care section.
The provider's emergency plan does not address continuity of care.
The emergency preparedness plan did not include information regarding how care will continue in the event of an emergency evacuation of the home.
The emergency preparedness plan did not specify procedures for:  Communication with authorities,  Continue care when relocating and  Reunifying children with families.
